command:
set -eu
printf 'NODE=%s IP=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf '%s\n' '--- platform ---'
cat /etc/os-release
uname -r
printf 'pkg_manager='; if command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then dnf --version | sed -n '1p'; elif command -v yum >/dev/null 2>&1; then yum --version | sed -n '1p'; elif command -v rpm >/dev/null 2>&1; then rpm --version; else printf 'unknown\n'; fi
printf 'service_manager='; systemctl --version | sed -n '1p'
printf '%s\n' '--- identities ---'
getent passwd inventorysvc || true
getent group inventory-readers || true
id inventorysvc || true
printf '%s\n' '--- filesystem and security ---'
findmnt -T /srv/inventory -o TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS
getenforce 2>/dev/null || true
ls -ldZ /srv /srv/inventory
stat -c 'root path=%n type=%F owner=%U(%u) group=%G(%g) mode=%a links=%h' /srv/inventory
printf 'entries='; find /srv/inventory -mindepth 1 -printf . | wc -c
printf 'regular_files='; find /srv/inventory -type f -printf . | wc -c
printf 'symlinks='; find /srv/inventory -type l -printf . | wc -c
printf '%s\n' '--- existing metadata summary ---'
find /srv/inventory -xdev -printf '%y %u %g %m\n' | sort | uniq -c
printf '%s\n' '--- acl summary ---'
if command -v getfacl >/dev/null 2>&1; then getfacl -R -c -p /srv/inventory 2>/dev/null | sha256sum; getfacl -p /srv/inventory; else printf 'getfacl unavailable\n'; fi
printf '%s\n' '--- content/namespace preservation digest ---'
find /srv/inventory -xdev -printf '%P\0%y\0%l\0' | sort -z | sha256sum
find /srv/inventory -xdev -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 -r sha256sum | sha256sum
printf '%s\n' '--- services and listeners ---'
systemctl --failed --no-legend || true
systemctl list-units --type=service --state=running --no-legend --no-pager
ss -lntup
printf '%s\n' '--- package versions relevant to permission tooling ---'
rpm -q coreutils acl policycoreutils selinux-policy-targeted 2>/dev/null || true

command -v setpriv >/dev/null
printf '%s\n' '--- service-owner behavior ---'
setpriv --reuid=inventorysvc --regid=inventory-readers --init-groups sh -c '
  test -r /srv/inventory && test -w /srv/inventory && test -x /srv/inventory
  find /srv/inventory -xdev -type f -exec sh -c '\''for f do test -r "$f" && test -w "$f" && dd if="$f" of=/dev/null status=none || exit 1; done'\'' sh {} +

printf '%s\n' '--- inventory-readers behavior ---'

  test -r /srv/inventory && test ! -w /srv/inventory && test -x /srv/inventory
  find /srv/inventory -xdev -type f -exec sh -c '\''for f do test -r "$f" && test ! -w "$f" && dd if="$f" of=/dev/null status=none || exit 1; done'\'' sh {} +
'
